basic_info.description: Bright & Spacious Lakeshore Home with Ideal Layout    Welcome to 3801 Ocean Avenue - a fully detached, split-level 3 bed, 3 bath corner home in the desirable Lakeshore neighborhood. Garden level room great for office. This spacious 2,319 sq ft residence (per graphic artist) features all bedrooms on one level, offering a highly sought-after layout with exceptional flow and natural light throughout.    Enjoy a formal living room with fireplace, separate dining room, and a charming breakfast nook that doubles as a pantry or home office. Recent upgrades include a new heating system (2025), a new composition shingle roof (2021), and freshly landscaped outdoor space. The home also features a fire sprinkler system, ample storage, and 1-car garage parking.    Conveniently located near Muni lines (M, K, 18, 23, 28, 29, 43, 58, 91), Balboa Park BART, and easy access to Hwy 101, Hwy 280, and the Great Highway. Just minutes to Whole Foods, Ocean Avenue, West Portal, Stonestown, Lakeshore Plaza, Lake Merced, Stern Grove, Harding Park Golf Course, SFSU, and top-rated schools including Lowell and St. Ignatius.    Don't miss this light-filled Lakeshore gem!
